g.text: Use DateOnly (calendar date), TimeOnly (time of day), TimeSpan (duration) or DateTimeOffset in UTC
(instant); DateTime only at interop boundaries, converted immediately
Use IHttpClientFactory (AddHttpClient) — a new HttpClient per call exhausts sockets
The symbol 'DateTimeOffset.UtcNow' is banned in this project: Inject TimeProvider and use GetUtcNow()
